subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should the accepted fix be a lint/validation command only, or must normal `skills list`, `skills check`, `skills.status`, and Web console output also surface skipped malformed `SKILL.md` candidates before this issue is considered fixed?
rationale: Current main still lacks the requested diagnostics, and the open candidate PR implements a plausible lint-first path while the issue explicitly asks for broader normal CLI/Web visibility.

options.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
options.body: Treat lint as useful but incomplete unless skipped-candidate diagnostics also reach the maintainer-approved list/check/status/Web user path.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land a corrected `skills lint` flow as the first supported diagnostic surface and leave status/Web warnings to a linked follow-up.

options.title: Pause until scope is narrowed
options.body: Keep the issue and candidate PR paused until maintainers decide the redaction, noise, and UI scope for malformed skill reporting.

recommendation.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat lint as useful but incomplete unless skipped-candidate diagnostics also reach the maintainer-approved list/check/status/Web user path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history places this person on the skill-loading/status surfaces most directly affected by the scope choice.
